title: Kimia Degani
description: Kimia has had a passion for Family Law since High School and works to ensure that clients are able to navigate the divorce process smoothly.
html:
Kimia is currently in her third year of university studying a Bachelor of Law/Bachelor of Communication (Writing and Publishing) at the University of Technology Sydney. Studying a double degree that combines writing and law further advances her ability to fulfil her role at Nolan Lawyers.

Kimia has had a passion for Family Law since High School, and has gained a variety of skills to pursue this field since the commencement of her studies. Kimia works to ensure that clients feel supported and are able to navigate the divorce process smoothly.
